name: OpenDeepWiki
description: Turns Git repositories, ZIP archives and local folders into generated wiki docs with chat and MCP access.
whatItDoes: Analyses a code base and writes structured documentation for it, then serves the result as a public site that can also be queried by chat. It is for teams that want browsable, AI-generated knowledge bases for their repositories.
howItWorks: A .NET backend imports the source, uses separate models to build the documentation catalogue and write the content, and publishes it through a Next.js site. The same index backs chat, an embeddable widget and an MCP endpoint. It starts with Docker Compose on SQLite, or PostgreSQL with an alternate compose file.
